pr_title: fix(runner): friendly error message instead of "digests do not match"

issue_context.title: [BUG] Error: Digests do not match
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version: 1.21.1
- Operating System: Mac
- Node.js version: 18.2.0
- Browser: Chromium


**Describe the bug**

I've got this error in one of my test case when running multiple test suites with multiple workers. 
"Error: Digests do not match"

What could be the problem here? I'm using playwright for couple of months and this is the first time encountering this issue after setting up some custom fixtures. 

**Some Observations**
- It isn't related with the multiple workers. I've also tried with 1 worker and still got the error. 
- It is however connected with worker count somehow since the error is thrown in different suites with changing worker count.
- It is most probably related to custom fixtures.
- Error is thrown when starting the first case of the test suite and all other cases in the suite is skipped. 
- Also tried in 1.22.2 and got the same error
comments: @kryaksy This is an internal assertion that should not ever hit 😄 Could you please share a repro, so we can fix this?
@dgozman It works. Thank you for your support.
For the reference, we decided not to proceed with a risky fix in #14598. I'll merge a PR with an improved error message as a mitigation strategy.
